y-m-22-07.title: Singasho yini 'kabili kakhulu' ngokuphakama kwamabha kuphela?
y-m-22-07.topic: Ukufunda ama-histogram: ukuthi ukuqala kwe-axis eqondile kuthinta kanjani ukuqhathanisa ukuphakama kwamabha
y-m-22-07.goal: Qaphela ukuthi ku-histogram lapho i-axis eqondile ingaqali ku-0 isilinganiso sokuphakama kwamabha sihluke kwesokuvama, hlulela umehluko ngokuvama kwangempela, bese ukubhala kabusha njengesaziso esingabangeli ukungaqondi.
y-m-22-07.material:
I-histogram yanyatheliswa esazisweni somtapo wolwazi. Yahlukanisa abafundi abangu-142 ngamakilasi amathathu ngokwenani lezincwadi abazibolekile enyangeni.
[I-histogram echazwe ngamazwi] I-axis evundlile ikhombisa 'izincwadi ezingu-0 noma ngaphezulu futhi ngaphansi kuka-5', 'izincwadi ezingu-5 noma ngaphezulu futhi ngaphansi kuka-10', kanye 'nezincwadi ezingu-10 noma ngaphezulu futhi ngaphansi kuka-15'. I-axis eqondile inani labafundi, namamaki kusukela phansi kuya phezulu ku-40, 44, 48, 52 abafundi. Ngaphansi kwemaki engu-40 ayidwetshwanga emfanekisweni. Ukuvama kwangempela kwamabha amathathu kungu-46, 52, 44 abafundi ngokulandelana.
Isaziso: "Abafundi abaningi kakhulu babolekile izincwadi ezingu-5 noma ngaphezulu futhi ngaphansi kuka-10! Cishe kabili kunamanye amakilasi."

y-m-22-08.topic: Isilinganiso nokusatshalaliswa kwedatha: inani lamanani angaphezu kwesilinganiso
y-m-22-08.goal: Hlola ngokwenza izibonelo eziphikisayo wena ukuthi umbono othi 'amanani angaphezu nangaphansi kwesilinganiso cishe ayalingana' uhlala ulungile yini, bese uchaza ukuthi kungani isilinganiso ne-median kuziphatha ngendlela ehlukile mayelana nenani lamanani aphezulu.
y-m-22-08.material: Sikhuluma ngamaphuzu emisebenzi yabafundi abangu-5 (izinombolo ezigcwele kusukela ku-0 kuya ku-100). UMina uthe, "Abafundi abathole amaphuzu aphezulu kunesilinganiso bahlala bengabantu abangaba uhhafu wabo bonke, futhi uhhafu omunye uthole amaphuzu aphansi kunesilinganiso." Isilinganiso yinani olithola ngokwengeza amaphuzu abafundi abangu-5 bese uhlukanisa ngo-5. Umfundi onamaphuzu alingana nesilinganiso akafakwa ohlangothini 'olungaphezulu' noma 'olungaphansi'.

8, 12, 15, 17, 18, 21, 22, 23, 25, 26, 28, 31, 34, 37, 41, 55
Lawa marekhodi ahlelwe ethebuleni lemvamisa. Kunezigaba ezinhlanu, zonke zinosayizi ofanayo, ezibhalwe njengo-'okungenani izikhathi ezingu-○ futhi ngaphansi kwezikhathi ezingu-○'. Isigaba sokuqala siqala ku-a izikhathi noma ngaphezulu futhi ububanzi besigaba buyizikhathi ezingu-w (u-a uyinombolo yemvelo engu-0 noma ngaphezulu, u-w uyinombolo yemvelo engu-1 noma ngaphezulu). Okungukuthi, izigaba ziya ngokulandelana: a noma ngaphezulu futhi ngaphansi kuka-a+w, a+w noma ngaphezulu futhi ngaphansi kuka-a+2w, … Izimo ezilandelayo kumele zigcinwe. ① Amarekhodi abafundi bonke abangu-16 awela ngaphakathi kwezigaba ezinhlanu ② Akukho sigaba esingenalutho ③ Akukho sigaba esinabafundi abangaphezu kwabangu-8 (ingxenye yesamu eliphelele).
